verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way for users to set up automations, scheduled jobs or background agents that run on their own. Incremental materialized views transform data at insert time, and ClickPipes handle data ingestion; both are related features rather than user-defined background automations. The AI notebooks agent is interactive and still on a waitlist. Background automation is a fair question for a database or cloud data platform, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
